display.purpose: Wordmark and drawer org name. Monospace identity.

body.purpose: Field values and prose. Reading voice.

shadows.name: drawer-lift
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the system; lifts the slide-over profile drawer above the page.

motion.name: hover
motion.purpose: All hover/state transitions on rows, buttons, inputs.

motion.name: drawer-slide
motion.purpose: Profile drawer slide-in from the right.

components.name: Export Button
components.description: Quiet outlined primary action; inverts to filled ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #18181B; border: 1px solid #18181B; border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: 'Fira Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #18181B; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #EC4899; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Sync Button
components.description: Secondary outlined action with hairline border that darkens on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #3F3F46; border: 1px solid #D4D4D8; border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: 'Fira Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #18181B; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Active filter only; magenta dismiss control.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: #18181B; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'Fira Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-chip-x { color: #EC4899; background: none; border: none; padding: 0; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; font-size: 14px; }

components.name: Confidence Badge
components.description: Semantic confidence/classification marker; color always paired with text.
components.css: .ds-badge { font-family: 'Fira Code', monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 2px; display: inline-block; } .ds-badge-high { background: #DCFCE7; color: #15803D; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Off-white field that brightens to white with ink border on focus.
components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; max-width: 480px; } .ds-search-icon { position: absolute; left: 12px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); } .ds-search-input { width: 100%; padding: 10px 12px 10px 36px; font-family: 'Fira Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; background: #FAFAFA; border: 1px solid #E4E4E7; border-radius: 4px; color: #09090B; transition: background 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-search-input::placeholder { color: #71717A; } .ds-search-input:focus { outline: none; background: #FFFFFF; border-color: #18181B; }

components.name: KPI Pull-Quote Card
components.description: Borderless stat block; 3px ink top-rule, large mono number, muted label.
components.css: .ds-kpi { border-top: 3px solid #18181B; padding: 20px 24px 16px; background: #FFFFFF; } .ds-kpi-number { font-family: 'Fira Code', monospace; font-size: 32px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; color: #18181B; } .ds-kpi-label { font-family: 'Fira Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #71717A; margin-top: 6px; }

components.name: Leads Row
components.description: Signature row: 3px transparent left edge turns magenta on hover, the editorial selection mark.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 12px 16px; border-left: 3px solid transparent; border-bottom: 1px solid #F4F4F5; background: #FFFFFF; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-row:hover { border-left-color: #EC4899; background: #F4F4F5; } .ds-row-org { font-family: 'Fira Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #18181B; } .ds-row-meta { font-family: 'Fira Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: #71717A; }

narrative.overview: Qalara LMS reads like a well-set financial broadsheet rather than a control panel. The data is the headline; the interface is the typesetting around it. A monospaced display face (Fira Code) sets section labels, KPIs, and identifiers with the precision of a printed ledger, while a humanist sans (Fira Sans) carries the prose. Thin black rules organize the page the way a newspaper uses column separators: structure without boxes. Color is almost absent, held in reserve so that the single magenta accent and the three confidence colors carry real meaning the instant they appear.
keyCharacteristics: Monospace for identity and data; humanist sans for reading.
Near-monochrome surface; magenta and confidence colors are the only saturated voices.
Hairline black rules instead of cards and shadows.
Calm density: many fields, little noise.
Honest states everywhere (loading skeletons, empty teaching states, error lines).

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Magenta appears on ≤10% of any screen. Its rarity is the entire point; the moment it decorates, it stops signaling.

rules.name: The Rules-Not-Boxes Rule
rules.body: Grouping is done with 1px rules (ink for section dividers, hairline for rows), never with bordered cards. Nested cards are forbidden.

rules.name: The Mono-for-Identity Rule
rules.body: Anything that identifies or quantifies is set in Fira Code; anything read as language is set in Fira Sans. The font tells the user what kind of thing they're looking at.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. The only shadow in the system belongs to the drawer.

dos: Do keep magenta (#EC4899) on ≤10% of any screen — active filters, the row mark, the dismiss control, the intelligence spark, nothing else.
Do organize with 1px rules: ink (#18181B) for section dividers, hairline (#E4E4E7) for table rows.
Do set every label, KPI, badge, and identifier in Fira Code; set every reading sentence in Fira Sans.
Do pair every confidence/classification color with its text value, so color is never the only signal (WCAG AA).
Do ship honest states: skeleton rows while loading, a teaching empty state, inline error lines in the terminal.
Do keep body and placeholder text at ≥4.5:1 contrast; bump toward ink before reaching for a lighter gray.
donts: Don't build a generic SaaS dashboard: no gradient hero-metric tiles, no blue-and-white template, no rounded-everything.
Don't build a cluttered enterprise CRM: no wall of competing buttons, tabs, and panels.
Don't let it become a spreadsheet-in-a-browser: the drawer, typography, and rhythm must always show craft.
Don't use cards where a rule will do, and never nest cards.
Don't add shadows to anything except the drawer.
Don't use border-left/border-right greater than the 3px magenta row mark as a colored stripe.
Don't introduce consumer-app playfulness: no emojis as icons, no bouncy/elastic motion, no illustrations.
Don't set body copy in ALL CAPS or use uppercase for anything longer than a four-word label.
